name: SolarDesignVoxelizer
description: Component 1. Split a closed DesignVolume into numbered, traceable, boundary-clipped column voxels. Outputs feed SolarVoxelOptimizer unchanged.

inputParameters.name: DesignVolume
inputParameters.description: One or more valid closed solids to voxelize. Accepts Grasshopper geometry, a Rhino document Guid, an ObjRef or a RhinoObject. SubD is ignored with a warning in Rhino 7; convert it to a Brep or closed Mesh first.

inputParameters.name: VoxelSizeXY
inputParameters.description: Voxel edge length on the world X and Y axes, in model units. In a millimetre file 3000 means 3 metres.

inputParameters.name: VoxelSizeZ
inputParameters.description: Voxel layer height on the world Z axis, in model units.

inputParameters.name: Run
inputParameters.description: Set to True to voxelize. Leave False while wiring the inputs.

outputParameters.name: Voxels
outputParameters.description: Flat list of voxel geometry. Fully contained cells are boxes; boundary cells are clipped to DesignVolume.

outputParameters.name: VoxelIDs
outputParameters.description: Flat list of voxel IDs, aligned item by item with Voxels.

outputParameters.name: ColumnIDs
outputParameters.description: Flat list of column IDs grouping voxels by world XY grid location.

outputParameters.name: LayerIDs
outputParameters.description: Flat list of global world-Z layer indices. May contain gaps when the input does.

outputParameters.name: VoxelCenters
outputParameters.description: Flat list of voxel centres. Clipped cells report their true centroid.

outputParameters.name: VoxelVolumes
outputParameters.description: Flat list of true solid volumes in cubic model units.

outputParameters.name: VoxelTree
outputParameters.description: Branch {c} holds the voxels of ColumnID c, ordered bottom to top.

outputParameters.name: Report
outputParameters.description: Status, grid statistics, Boolean failure counts, warnings and errors.
